summary: The bad() method placed the ZipFile.close() inside the try block after zFile.size(). If opening the ZipFile or calling size() throws a ZipException or IOException, control jumps to the catch blocks and the close is never executed, leaking the ZipFile resource (CWE-404). The fix moves the resource cleanup into a finally block so the ZipFile is always closed regardless of whether an exception occurs, while preserving the feature of opening the file and reporting its entry count.
